detail.longDescription: Using OpenLayers since 2015, I moved smoothly to latest version up to v10.7. The bug occurs since v10.8 (and later to v10.11). The instruction that fails - in try...catch - is right after printing "before": console.log("before ..."); // 1. Create an initially empty map. const olMap = new OLMap({ target: options.target, view: new View({ 'center': fromLonLat(options.center), 'zoom': options.zoom, 'extent': WERMAEXTENT, 'projection': OUTPROJ }) }); console.log("after map"); which yields: before ... Uncaught (in promise) Error: Error: in prepareMap t.view.then is not a function for I can console.log just before but not after. I am stuck in v10.7 and I dont know from where promise t.view may come. The release notes for v10.8 mention "Functions for transforming a promise for a view by @tschaub in #17197" but I do not see what could be at fault
